name: nano-cortex-editor
description: Unofficial desktop editor for the Neural DSP Nano Cortex (macOS and Windows): presets, every block, captures, footswitches, expression, tempo, tuner, metronome and Cortex Cloud capture transfer over Bluetooth.
author: AJs Creations

scripts.start: npm run build:core && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build:core && npm run build:icon && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.test:ux: npm run build:core && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron test/ux-test.js
scripts.docs:screenshots: npm run build:core && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron scripts/docs-screenshots.js && python3 scripts/docs-images.py

extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Nano Cortex Editor connects to your Nano Cortex over Bluetooth to read and edit presets.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Nano Cortex Editor connects to your Nano Cortex over Bluetooth.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Only needed to list your audio outputs for the metronome; the microphone is never recorded.
